verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «مَوْتِ ٱلِٱبْنِ». مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ أَحْمَدُ ٱلرَّبَّ بِكُلِّ قَلْبِي. أُحَدِّثُ بِجَمِيعِ عَجَائِبِكَ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David. I will praise [thee], O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

verses.ar: أَفْرَحُ وَأَبْتَهِجُ بِكَ. أُرَنِّمُ لِٱسْمِكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْعَلِيُّ.
verses.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.web: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

verses.ar: عِنْدَ رُجُوعِ أَعْدَائِي إِلَى خَلْفٍ، يَسْقُطُونَ وَيَهْلِكُونَ مِنْ قُدَّامِ وَجْهِكَ،
verses.kjv: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.web: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَقَمْتَ حَقِّي وَدَعْوَايَ. جَلَسْتَ عَلَى ٱلْكُرْسِيِّ قَاضِيًا عَادِلًا.
verses.kjv: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.web: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

verses.ar: ٱنْتَهَرْتَ ٱلْأُمَمَ. أَهْلَكْتَ ٱلشِّرِّيرَ. مَحَوْتَ ٱسْمَهُمْ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.web: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

verses.ar: اَلْعَدُوُّ تَمَّ خَرَابُهُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. وَهَدَمْتَ مُدُنًا. بَادَ ذِكْرُهُ نَفْسُهُ.
verses.kjv: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.web: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلرَّبُّ فَإِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ يَجْلِسُ. ثَبَّتَ لِلْقَضَاءِ كُرْسِيَّهُ،
verses.kjv: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.web: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ يَقْضِي لِلْمَسْكُونَةِ بِٱلْعَدْلِ. يَدِينُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ بِٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.web: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

verses.ar: وَيَكُونُ ٱلرَّبُّ مَلْجَأً لِلْمُنْسَحِقِ. مَلْجَأً فِي أَزْمِنَةِ ٱلضِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.web: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

verses.ar: وَيَتَّكِلُ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْعَارِفُونَ ٱسْمَكَ، لِأَنَّكَ لَمْ تَتْرُكْ طَالِبِيكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.kjv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.web: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

verses.ar: رَنِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ ٱلسَّاكِنِ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ، أَخْبِرُوا بَيْنَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ بِأَفْعَالِهِ.
verses.kjv: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.web: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مُطَالِبٌ بِٱلدِّمَاءِ. ذَكَرَهُمْ. لَمْ يَنْسَ صُرَاخَ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ.
verses.kjv: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.web: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

verses.ar: اِرْحَمْنِي يَارَبُّ. ٱنْظُرْ مَذَلَّتِي مِنْ مُبْغِضِيَّ، يَارَافِعِي مِنْ أَبْوَابِٱلْمَوْتِ،
verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble [which I suffer] of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

verses.ar: لِكَيْ أُحَدِّثَ بِكُلِّ تَسَابِيحِكَ فِي أَبْوَابِ ٱبْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ، مُبْتَهِجًا بِخَلَاصِكَ.
verses.kjv: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.web: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

verses.ar: تَوَرَّطَتِ ٱلْأُمَمُ فِي ٱلْحُفْرَةِ ٱلَّتِي عَمِلُوهَا. فِي ٱلشَّبَكَةِ ٱلَّتِي أَخْفَوْهَا ٱنْتَشَبَتْ أَرْجُلُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: The heathen are sunk down in the pit [that] they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.web: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

verses.ar: مَعْرُوفٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ. قَضَاءً أَمْضَى. ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يَعْلَقُ بِعَمَلِ يَدَيْهِ. ضَرْبُ ٱلْأَوْتَارِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: The LORD is known [by] the judgment [which] he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.web: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

verses.ar: اَلْأَشْرَارُ يَرْجِعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ، كُلُّ ٱلْأُمَمِ ٱلنَّاسِينَ ٱللهَ.
verses.kjv: The wicked shall be turned into hell, [and] all the nations that forget God.
verses.web: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا يُنْسَى ٱلْمِسْكِينُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. رَجَاءُ ٱلْبَائِسِينَ لَا يَخِيبُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.kjv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall [not] perish for ever.
verses.web: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

verses.ar: قُمْ يَارَبُّ. لَا يَعْتَزَّ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ. لِتُحَاكَمِ ٱلْأُمَمُ قُدَّامَكَ.
verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.web: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ ٱجْعَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ رُعْبًا لِيَعْلَمَ ٱلْأُمَمُ أَنَّهُمْ بَشَرٌ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Put them in fear, O LORD: [that] the nations may know themselves [to be but] men. Selah.
verses.web: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
